definitions.explanation: In music, a combination of tones that sounds harsh or unstable.
Figuratively, a lack of harmony in relationships or situations.

examples.japanese: この{曲|きょく}は{意図的|いとてき}に{不協和音|ふきょうわおん}を{使|つか}っている。
チームに{不協和音|ふきょうわおん}が{生|しょう}じている。
examples.english: Discord has arisen within the team.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}{内|ない}の{不協和音|ふきょうわおん}が{報道|ほうどう}された。
examples.english: Friction within the government was reported.

notes:
KANJI:
{不|ふ} (non-) + {協和|きょうわ} (harmony) + {音|おん} (sound)
Literal: "non-harmony sound"

MUSICAL VS. FIGURATIVE:
・Musical: a chord that creates tension needing resolution
・Figurative: conflict or disagreement, especially in organizations

OPPOSITE:
・{協和音|きょうわおん} - consonance, harmony

COLLOCATIONS:
・{不協和音|ふきょうわおん}が{生|しょう}じる (discord arises)
・{不協和音|ふきょうわおん}を{奏|かな}でる (to create dissonance/discord)
